description: This file defines the SnackBarOpener class, an Angular service that listens for parser errors and displays notifications using Angular Material's snack bar component.

classes.name: SnackBarOpener
classes.description: An Angular service that implements UserNotificationListener to display parser error messages via snack bar notifications.

methods.name: onParserErrors
methods.description: Handles parser errors by converting them to messages and displaying them in a snack bar.

methods.name: convertErrorsToMessages
methods.description: Converts a list of parser errors into a list of user-friendly message strings.

methods.name: convertErrorToMessage
methods.description: Converts a single parser error into a descriptive message string.

methods.name: makeCroppedMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating that some error messages have been cropped for brevity.

methods.name: groupErrorsByType
methods.description: Groups parser errors by their error type.
